messages:
samir: Auditor Jane asked for a replayable evidence bundle for SOC2: RBAC change history, audit logs for 2025-10-01..2025-10-07, KMS rotation history, vuln-triage notes, and incident linkages. Can we scope and produce a plan? ping @maria @liam

maria: Quick Q - do they want raw logs or redacted exports? :thinking:

auditor_jane: Raw is preferred for chain of custody but we can accept redacted exports IF you provide a hash manifest and signing. Export must be reproducible and include instructions to verify. See internal template: https://redwood-internal/audit/templates/replay.md

liam: For raw we'd provide an S3 export + presigned links and a manifest. Temp creds must be rotated and STS usage recorded. We should decide Splunk->S3 export ranges. @infra-bot can you queue an export for the window?

infra-bot: infra-bot: queued export job id=exp-20251006-001 sources=[k8s_audit,api_gateway,auth_service,splunk_logs] window=2025-10-01T00:00:00Z..2025-10-07T23:59:59Z

maria: Window OK. We'll redact PII before handing over. Proposed redaction (example):

```
jq 'del(.user.email, .request.body.password, .request.body.ssn, .headers.Authorization)' logs.ndjson > logs.redacted.ndjson
```

samir: Auditor also wants KMS key rotation timeline + key policy snapshots and CloudTrail events for KMS. Liam - can you capture that and include CMK ARNs?

liam: Yep. I'll pull key rotation status and CloudTrail slices. Commands I plan to run:

```
aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-10-01 --end-time 2025-10-07
```

liam: I'll put key metadata + rotation.csv in the keys/ folder in the export. :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: Please include a short narrative describing how the export is protected (in transit + at rest), which KMS key encrypted the bundle, and who has access. Also need MD5/SHA256 checksums and manifest signed with your audit-signing key.

maria: For signing we use an asymmetric KMS key alias/role: alias/audit-signing. Example sign step:

```
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-signing --message fileb://manifest.json --message-type RAW --output text --query Signature
```

samir: Also include vuln triage links and short notes for anything in the window that might be relevant. Example: CVE-2025-3344 (authlib) patched 2025-09-28, ticket #INC-4821. Add a one-paragraph summary per ticket.

liam: For RBAC changes, I'll export infra-config PRs labeled "rbac" and generate a CSV with columns: pr, author, merged_at, diff_link. That plus git history should satisfy the change history trace.

maria: I'll prepare custody.csv with columns: exported_by, exported_at, s3_object, checksum, checksum_algo, signed_by. We'll compute sha256sum for every object.

auditor_jane: ETA? We need manifest + signing sample before we approve access window.

samir: ETA: manifest + sample (keys + 1 log slice + manifest) by EOD tomorrow. Full export in 48h after that. @auditor_jane :eyes:

auditor_jane: Sounds fine. Please ensure no PII artifacts slip through. We'll request access window after receiving manifest and verification steps.

infra-bot: infra-bot: export job exp-20251006-001 started: copying 12.3GB -> s3://redwood-audit-temp/exp-20251006-001/; presigned_urls will be created when complete

maria: Running redaction check now, then sha256sum and sign manifest. Will attach redaction log to manifest.

liam: Uploaded keys/key_rotation.csv and cloudtrail/kms_slice.ndjson to s3://redwood-audit-temp/exp-20251006-001/keys/ ; manifest entry example: keys/key_rotation.csv sha256:abcd1234ef567890...

samir: Looping closed — once presigned URLs ready we'll share via encrypted email and update the SOC2 ticket.

auditor_jane: :thumbsup: thanks all.
